title: The primary decomposition theorem
objectives: State the primary decomposition theorem over an arbitrary field
Build the component projections from a Bezout identity
Prove that each restriction has a prime-power minimal polynomial
Apply the decomposition to invariant subspaces and generalized eigenspaces
prerequisites: Minimal polynomial, polynomial ideals, direct sums and projections (Chapters 13 and 15 to 18).
source_scope: The captions of the two recordings (positions 38 and 39) were read in full. The 3 by 3 block of the running example is the matrix discussed in the first recording; the quarter-turn block, the corollaries, laboratory and exercises are original.
